Subject: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal (logs & retention)

Hi Soojin,

We just kicked off our renewal review and our security team flagged we need an updated SOC2 attestation window to cover our renewal date. Two asks from our side: 1) can you confirm current audit log retention windows and options for extending to 12 months (we currently see 90 days in the Console), and 2) we may be expanding seats/capacity next quarter and would like any pricing/term guidance tied to that change.

Attached is a quick scope doc from our side with the services they want to include (FinApp_Scope_Request.xlsx). Can we schedule a 30-min sync next week? Auditor (KPMG) wants preliminary evidence lists by Apr 20.

Thanks,
Olivia

Hi Olivia — thanks for the scope and heads-up. We can support a 12-month retention option but it requires a brief config change and will affect storage billing.

High level proposal:
- Redwood will assemble the SOC2 evidence bundle (audit logs, IAM snapshots, KMS rotation proof, config exports). Neha will own the evidence pack.
- For 12-month retention we offer a "retention add-on" that persists logs in cold storage; pricing and contract term will be handled by Marissa.
- If you are planning a seat or capacity uplift we can present a combined renewal amendment with a discounted uplift structure (Marissa).

Can you share the auditor contact and preferred date/time for a kickoff? I can run a 30-min call next Tue (Apr 9) 10:00-10:30 PT.

Best,

Subject: Re: FW: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal (logs & retention)

Thanks for the ping. Quick technical summary:
- Current default: 90 days of searchable audit logs in hot storage, 12 months available via cold export (cost applies). We can enable a "12mo retention" flag scoped to specific projects/namespaces.
- Evidence we can produce within 3 business days (for the 90-day window): immutable audit log bundles, API access logs, IAM snapshot, KMS rotation records, deployment/config change history. I have a short how-to for exports (logs_export_instructions.md).
- For full 12-month in-place retention (searchable) we need a procurement-approved add-on and a brief data-retention policy update because of storage & compliance checks; expect 7-10 business days for config and validation.

Risk note: if FinApp adds in-scope systems not currently covered in our SOC2 scope we will need an updated auditor attestation which lengthens timeline. Recommend we confirm scope now.

Action items:
- I will assemble the preliminary evidence bundle for the 90-day window by Apr 11. (attachment: logs_export_instructions.md)
- If they confirm 12-month retention by Apr 10, we can target a completed config and export readiness by Apr 19.

-Neha
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Hi Olivia — following up with commercial details so we can get ahead of the renewal amendment.

Proposal (high level):
- Retention Add-on: one-time provisioning + monthly storage fee. For 12-month retention we propose $4,200/month for the scoped projects listed in your spreadsheet.
- Seat uplift: from 200 to 300 seats — we can offer a 12% discount on net-new seats if you commit at renewal.
- Dedicated capacity burst: add 4x T4 GPUs for scheduled peak windows; pricing attached in the proposal.

If that looks reasonable I can generate an amendment and send via DocuSign for signature; I included a draft commercial_proposal_v1.pdf for review.

Next steps: confirm scope (so Neha can finish evidence pack) and confirm whether procurement needs a PO or will accept DocuSign.
